source: PermaLoad.bundle Ability/ActorData + boss actor prefab bundles + ability prefabs (UnityPy)
schema:
boss_attacks.json: per boss ActorData, every ability that references/belongs to the boss and carries a DamageStatsHolder component. actorLevel = ActorData.level (L0 in the ActorScaler); actorStatsLevel = ActorStats.level; actorStats = the boss prefab's own ActorStats.stats (le_assets.norm_stat form). abilities[]: name (Ability asset), abilityName (display), key (AbilityRef key), matchedBy = how the ability was attached to the boss: 'prefab:. @' (AbilityRef/PPtr found in the actor prefab), 'namePrefix:

' (Ability asset name starts with the boss name prefix; heuristic, may include abilities of related actors), 'subAbility:...' (referenced by another matched ability; 'parents' lists them). components[]: go = GameObject path in the ability prefab ('[nested X via field]' prefix = a prefab soft-referenced by the ability prefab, e.g. a projectile), class, damage[7] in order Physical, Fire, Cold, Lightning, Necrotic, Void, Poison (damageByType = non-zero), isHit, critChance, critMultiplier, penetration, damageModifier, addedDamageScaling, increasedStunChance, freezeRate, ailments [{ailment, chance...}] on the same GameObject, timing = non-zero interval/duration/radius-like scalars of the component (DoT/repeat components). spawnsActors = actors the ability summons. helperActors[] = actors spawned by the boss prefab/abilities (recursive, depth<=3) with their own actorStats (Damage MORE etc.) and via; their abilities are included with viaActor = that helper (matchedBy 'helperActor:...'). Damage scaling for monsters (research/06c sec.7, tables in actor_scaler.json): the ActorScaler gives the monster a Damage MORE of (damageModifier[L]+1)*1.06-1 and a second MORE of originalDamageApproximation[L]/originalDamageApproximation[L0]-1 where L = the actual enemy level and L0 = actorLevel. Corruption adds a Damage MORE of 0.01*f(c) for hits and 0.005*f(c) for damage-over-time (c = monolith corruption). Ability use timings of monster abilities are NOT scaled here. Timeline end bosses were mapped by display name from the task list (MonolithTimeline assets hold no boss ActorData reference).
